chapterTitle: Chapter 11 Reactions of Alkyl Halides: Nucleophilic Substitutions and Eliminations
title: Problem 11-19

pages.text: PROBLEM 11-19 Which isomer would you expect to undergo E2 elimination faster, trans-1-bromo-4-tert-butylcyclohexane or cis-1-bromo-4-tert-butylcyclohexane? Draw each molecule in its more stable chair conformation, and explain your answer.
